head: My Anti-Rot Year: journal app to cut endless scrolling
dek: My Anti-Rot Year is a $6.99 year-long journal app for iPhone and iPad for people who lose their evenings to scrolling. It came out on 20 November and was #40 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 21 November.
details: Instead of strict goals and streaks, it gives monthly missions, daily or scheduled rituals with a tracker, and a list of things to read and learn. There's weekly planning and looking back, a photo and journal album you can export as a PDF, and sealed letters to your future self. The listing says it's one purchase with no subscription, works offline and keeps data on the device or in your iCloud backup. It's made by Ilayda Aktan.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 16 or later), App Store, $6.99
means: If you want to spend less time scrolling without a strict habit app, this one gives small tasks across a year.
todo: Read the listing's description of the monthly missions to see whether they suit you; there are no reviews yet.
